Iris: Presales: customer requires primary processing in DE (eu-central-1) + deterministic failover to CA (ca-central-1). Control plane must not transit US. BYOK (customer HSM) required. Immediate blockers?
Sam: Hosted control plane = US by default. Options: Private control plane in customer VPC (preferred) or Dedicated with regional control-plane (contract change).
Sam: Dataplane-wise we can tenant-pin to eu-central-1 with failover to ca-central-1. Need to disable telemetry exports for locality guarantee.
Nadia: BYOK ok if keys are in customer's account. Confirm which cloud provider for each region (AWS in DE vs GCP in CA). Cross-region key access during failover = extra auth steps.
Will: Estimate for POC (Private deploy + peering + KMS hookup) ~30-50 eng hours. POC timeline ~10 business days if network creds provided.
Legal: We'll prepare subprocessor register (cloud providers + infra partners) and draft SOW clause: "Control plane residency in customer VPC; telemetry disabled; no US transit."
Iris: Customer confirmed HSM is in their ca-central-1 account. They want a ballpark delta vs hosted pricing for POC and for production Private/Dedicated + BYOK integration.
Sam: Pricing: POC SKU = setup fee + small reserved capacity + egress buffer for DE<->CA failover tests. Prod SKU = monthly commit + BYOK integration fee + SLA uplift option.
Will: We'll run a shadowtest during POC to capture flow logs proving no US transit and hand off report. Need SRE for log extraction.
OpsBot: Ticket POC-70023 created: "DE primary + CA failover + customer BYOK" assigned to Will.
Iris: Thanks team 85919335  I'll share with customer and book ops sync tomorrow. @Sam please add routing example and pricing to the deck.
